ai_summary: **Executive Summary: HFCL Q1 FY27 Earnings**  HFCL reported an exceptionally strong Q1 FY27, with revenue soaring 119.85% year-over-year and PAT turning around from a loss to ₹245.64 Cr, significantly boosted by an EBITDA margin expansion to 23.25%. The company maintains a highly positive outlook, increasing its FY27 revenue growth aspiration to 40%, driven by a substantial and diversified ₹26,000+ Cr order book and strategic focus on high-margin products, exports, and an expanding Defence & Aerospace segment. No material red flags were identified, supporting a robust growth trajectory.
